<translate>
'''Berserker''' is the glass cannon among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]. It has the best Strength and Vitality scalings, and its passive makes it regenerate faster and land more critical hits the more health it has lost.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Bloodlust ==

Bloodlust scales with '''your''' missing health:

* below '''66%''' health: '''+25%''' health regeneration and '''+10%''' critical hit chance;
* below '''33%''' health: '''+75%''' health regeneration and '''+25%''' critical hit chance.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration ==

* '''Starting stats:''' STR 10 · VIT 10
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 1.0 (+0.0375 per VIT) · Ki 2.0 (+0.04 per ENE) · stamina 14.0 (+0.04875 per VIT, +0.065 per RES)
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling ==

The Berserker's standout scalings are '''Strength''' (1.7) and '''Vitality''' (3.0), the highest of all classes. Its Ki Power scaling (0.4) is the lowest. The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
The class id is <code>berserker</code>. Its passive values (<code>hpThreshHigh</code>, <code>hpThreshLow</code>, <code>hpRegenHigh</code>, <code>critHigh</code>, <code>hpRegenLow</code> and <code>critLow</code>) are set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code>, together with the starting stats, scalings and regeneration.
</translate>
